Gentle handheld, nearly locked, a slight drift toward him. He raps more slowly now: his head gives three slow nods toward the man off-frame right, as if conceding a point; the hand on his chest presses flat, then lifts an inch and returns; on the last beat he raises the beer bottle a few inches from his hip toward frame right, an offer. His feet stay planted, his shoulders loosen. Rain falls between him and the camera, the barrel fire flickers behind. Mouths move, no speech: sound is rain and fire crackle only.
Thanks.
